title: Sit, and How You Feel
label: ch:mr-wellbeing-verbs
canDo: I can run a short visit in Marathi -- seat my guest, say how I feel on the dative frame, say that I am sleepy, and accept an offer with chalel.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R23-wellbeing-verbs and produce the whole small scene from memory: basa, mala baram vatam, chalel -- then name which of the four verbs Marathi built for itself rather than inheriting.
